I am a marine biologist studying ecosystem dynamics, trophic interactions, and ecological modeling in marine systems.

## About me ##

My academic background spans multiple scales, from cellular biology and organism physiology to ecosystem dynamics. I first trained in small-scale biological processes before pursuing two Master's degrees: one in organismal biology and ecology focused on conservation and restoration, and another in oceanography, including physical and chemical processes, trophic interactions, and large-scale ecosystem dynamics. This training allows me to approach marine ecosystems as integrated systems across scales, from fine-scale processes to large-scale dynamics.


This portfolio presents my research projects, including my master's thesis and other academic work.
